title: Centralized Log Aggregation for Distributed Microservices
business: Organizations running distributed microservices across hybrid cloud environments that require unified visibility into system health.
problem: Fragmented log storage across multiple virtual machines and container instances prevents rapid troubleshooting and correlation of cross-service errors.
solution: Azure Log Analytics provides a centralized workspace to ingest, query, and analyze telemetry data from diverse sources using a unified Kusto Query Language interface.
steps: Provision an Azure Log Analytics workspace within the target resource group.
Configure diagnostic settings on compute resources to stream platform logs to the workspace.
Deploy the Azure Monitor agent to virtual machines to collect guest-level event logs.
Execute Kusto queries within the workspace to filter, aggregate, and visualize cross-service error patterns.
outcome: Improved mean time to resolution through unified log correlation and centralized diagnostic data access.
limitation: Data ingestion latency can occur during high-volume traffic spikes, which is checked by monitoring the ingestion delay metric in the workspace insights.
